open_configuration_file: open a corrade utility Configuration file and read key-value pairs from it
read_config_value: read a value from a Configuration object using bracket notation like config['someKey']
access_config_group: access a named group within a Configuration object using the group method
add_config_group: add a new group to a Configuration object using the add_group method
save_configuration: save a Configuration object to an INI-style file on disk using the save method
